title: Reclamation: Integrations
summary: Plan farms around weather, water, storage, power, maps, and settlement needs.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Logistics can restock food and seed kits. TutorialCore can explain missed basics. Wiki and Index keep crop and ingredient references close to the field work.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Tie farms to Logistics restocks, TutorialCore hints, Wiki crop notes, and Index ingredient records so food production becomes part of planning instead of a chore.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: If support addons are absent, keep fields close, irrigated, lit, and labeled. Manual harvest plans beat sprawling farms with no route back.

blocks.title: Integration Anchor
blocks.body: Use this reference when the related system is present; the manual path still works without it.
